title: format!("{e}") on Display-impl errors: use e.to_string() or inline in format
description: Several warn!/error! calls format error values inline (e.g. '...failed: {e}'). This is fine and idiomatic. However in std::io::Error::new(e.kind(), format!(...)) at lines 78-80 and 86-92, the format string duplicates the queue_dir variable into the error message — this is correct but the format! could be replaced with a chained .map_err() combinator for consistency with the rest of the codebase pattern. Minor.
